issue.title: Bug: [Perf degradation 40%] show platform temperature time increase - python import cost and tempershow/xcvrd architecture change

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

# Context
Command "show platform temperature" seems much slower in master, than in 202511.
We compared 202505 (Python 3.9), 202511 (Python 3.13), and master (Python 3.13) on DUTs.
Time increased from 1.148s to 1.921s.

On 202511, SFP temperatures are published into TEMPERATURE_INFO by thermalctld. tempershow only reads that table.
On master, community changes moved SFP ownership to xcvrd (TRANSCEIVER_DOM_* tables). tempershow was updated to read those tables and map logical port names back to legacy labels (xSFP module N Temp).

# Problem
Inside "show platform temperature", main script is **tempershow**.
1) SFP temperature architecture change (~+0.3s on tempershow path, 202511 → master)
tempershow time increase:
```markdown
┌─────────┬──────────┬───────────┬────────────────┬──────────┐
│Version  │Wall time │vs 202505  │cProfile total  │Func calls│
├─────────┼──────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────┤
│202505   │276.9 ms  │1.00x      │0.328 s         │114,869   │
├─────────┼──────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────┤
│202511   │301.5 ms  │1.09x      │0.498 s         │124,257   │
├─────────┼──────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────┤
│202605   │561.3 ms  │2.03x      │0.838 s         │255,719   │
├─────────┼──────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────┤
│master   │566.5 ms  │2.05x      │0.905 s         │255,719   │
└─────────┴──────────┴───────────┴────────────────┴──────────┘
```
  tempershow
    → utilities_common.platform_sfputil_helper
      → utilities_common.cli
      → sonic_platform_base
        → chassis_base
          → sfp_base
            → sonic_xcvr.xcvr_api_factory
              → CMIS / CDB firmware / VDM / fields / consts / YAML / netaddr...
We found utilities_common.platform_sfputil_helper is added to tempershow in master and 202605 by this PR:
tempershow reads xcvrd-managed tables [#4522](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4522)
It reused utilities_common.platform_sfputil_helper to **map EthernetN -> xSFP module N Temp**. That adds ~0.09s import + ~0.07s init/DB work per invocation, on top of extra SFP table reads.
Because thermalctld reads from TRANSCEIVER_DOM_TEMPERATURE [#747](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/pull/747)

Community changes altered where SFP temperature lives and how tempershow reads it.
Can we parse this file to get mapping, instead of import those extra modules?
/usr/share/sonic/hwsku/port_config.ini

2) Import time increase (Another 0.4s)
~72% of time is spent in import show.main, DB queries are ~0.01s.
But those changes are scattered, and they are functional changes, maybe not easy to update the code.
We can focus on 1st problem.
```markdown
| Module | Change (ins / del) | Change location |
|--------|-------------------|-----------------|
| show/main.py | +191 / -54 | top-level (2 new imports) + function bodies |
| show/vnet.py | +428 / -310 | function bodies |
| show/vxlan.py | +331 / -243 | function bodies |
| show/platform.py | +224 / -2 | function bodies |
| show/chassis_modules.py | +151 / -5 | function bodies (removed 1 import) |
| show/vlan.py | +119 / -57 | function bodies |
| show/srv6.py | +139 | function bodies |
| show/bgp_cli.py | +86 | function bodies |
| show/evpn.py | +80 (new file) | whole module |
| show/warm_restart.py | +56 / -7 | function bodies |
| show/muxcable.py | +36 / -21 | function bodies |
| show/interfaces/__init__.py | +38 / -2 | function bodies |
| show/bgp_common.py | +4 / -4 | function bodies |
| show/bgp_frr_v4.py | ~+31 | function bodies |
| show/bgp_frr_v6.py | ~+31 | function bodies |
| show/kdump.py | +1 / -1 | function body |
| show/stp.py | +1 / -1 | function body |
| show/vtysh_helper.py | +303 (new file) | whole module |
| show/plugins/* (7 files) | +266 / -192 | function bodies |
```
Master has more commits than 2605, which also caused some latency.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4247
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4123
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4499
If we can make them as lazy import, maybe can save time.

## 202511
SFP publisher: thermalctld → TEMPERATURE_INFO
DB key style: xSFP module 1 Temp
tempershow: reads TEMPERATURE_INFO only, no port-name mapping

## master
SFP publisher: xcvrd → TRANSCEIVER_DOM_*
DB key style: Ethernet0 (logical port name)
tempershow: reads TRANSCEIVER_DOM_* and maps Ethernet* → xSFP module N Temp

# Expected Behavior
show platform temperature time increase not so much.

Can we have some ways to improve this? Seems too many python imports to one simple cmd query like "show platform temperature".

### Steps to Reproduce

Use time command to measure the execution time of the cmd.
```bash
time show platform temperature
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual time is 1.921s, expected not so long, like 1.148s.

### Relevant log output
Detail analysis put in attachment.

### Attach files

[show_platform_temp_perf_analysis.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30459587/show_platform_temp_perf_analysis.md)

resolution.title: [tempershow]: Avoid heavy SFP/xcvr import for port-name mapping
resolution.description:
#### What I did

Fixed a ~40% performance regression in `show platform temperature` (which invokes the `tempershow` utility). Fixes sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#28529.

`tempershow` maps each logical port name (e.g. `Ethernet0`) to the legacy `xSFP module <N> Temp` sensor label. It previously built this mapping by calling `platform_sfputil_helper.load_platform_sfputil()`, which imports the entire `sonic_platform_base` -> `sonic_xcvr` transceiver-API stack (CMIS/CDB/VDM/yaml/netaddr) plus `utilities_common.cli`. That import chain dominates the command's runtime even though the actual STATE_DB temperature read only takes a few milliseconds.

#### How I did it

- Build the `{logical_port_name: front-panel index}` map directly from the platform port configuration via `portconfig.get_port_config`, reading the same `index` field that `SfpUtilHelper.read_porttab_mappings` uses. This pulls in only `swsscommon`/`sonic_py_common`, which `tempershow` already imports.
- Dropped the `utilities_common.platform_sfputil_helper` dependency (and the heavy `sonic_platform_base`/`sonic_xcvr` import chain it triggers) from `tempershow`.
- Preserved single-ASIC and multi-ASIC namespace handling; if the port config is unavailable, the display name falls back to the logical port name, exactly as before.
- The `xSFP module <N> Temp` labels are byte-for-byte unchanged — only the heavy import is removed.
- Added `tests/tempershow_test.py` covering the new mapping (single/multi-ASIC, missing/failing port config, invalid index) and the display-name fallback.

#### How to verify it

1. Run the unit tests:
   ```
   pytest tests/tempershow_test.py -v
   ```
2. On a switch, confirm that the output of `show platform temperature` (including every `xSFP module <N> Temp` row) is unchanged before and after this change.
3. Confirm the heavy import chain is gone:
   ```
   python3 -X importtime /usr/local/bin/tempershow 2>&1 | grep -E 'sonic_platform_base|sonic_xcvr|portconfig'
   ```
   Before: the `sonic_platform_base`/`sonic_xcvr` chain is imported (~40 ms cumulative). After: only `portconfig` (~0.5 ms) is imported.

**Hardware verification on a 202605 image** — Mellanox-SN2700 (single-ASIC, `SONiC.20260510.10`, internal-202605 build, Python 3.13). The DUT-tested commit is byte-for-byte identical to this PR's `scripts/tempershow` and `tests/tempershow_test.py`.

| Metric (7 runs each) | Baseline (heavy import) | Fixed (this PR) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| End-to-end `tempershow` real time — median | 0.328 s | **0.233 s (~29% faster)** |
| End-to-end `tempershow` real time — min / max | 0.297 s / 0.371 s | 0.224 s / 0.255 s |
| Isolated port-name mapping path | ~0.283 s (`platform_sfputil_helper`) | ~0.150 s (`portconfig.get_port_config`) |
| Heavy `sonic_platform_base`/`sonic_xcvr` chain at module load | ~41.7 ms | eliminated (only `portconfig`, ~0.57 ms) |

Functional correctness: output is 43 lines before and after, and all 32 `xSFP module <N> Temp` sensor labels (and their order) are byte-for-byte identical to the previous implementation.

#### Previous command output (if the output of a command-line utility has changed)

No change to command output. The `show platform temperature` / `tempershow` table (including the `xSFP module <N> Temp` labels) is identical before and after this change; only the runtime/import cost is reduced.

#### New command output (if the output of a command-line utility has changed)

N/A — output unchanged (see above).
